h1: The 7 Best Clip Clothes Hangers for Skirts, Pants and Shorts, Ranked & Reviewed
metaTitle: Best Clip Clothes Hangers: Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: 7 clip hangers for skirts, pants and kids' clothes, scored on clip grip, pack size, material, width and space saving.
summary: The Amazon Basics velvet 24-pack is the best clip hanger for a mixed closet, with dual clips, notched shoulders and a swivel hook. The HOUSE DAY clear 14 inch pack is the choice when clip marks are the concern, the HOME IT ivory velvet pants hangers suit light-colored closets, and the Hanger Central 12 inch pack works for kids' clothes.
intro: Clip hangers look interchangeable, but the clip itself is where they differ, and a bad clip ruins the clothing it is meant to protect. A clip that is too tight leaves a crease across a skirt hem. One that is too loose lets a pair of trousers slide to the floor. The right design pairs a clip with just enough spring with a pad on the jaw, so the pinch is wide and gentle instead of a hard line.

We ranked seven clip hangers on how they hold, what the jaws are made of, how much space they take and how many come in the pack. We reviewed listings, which state material, width, pack count and sometimes load, and we avoid claiming a grip strength the pages do not give. Wire and metal hangers can rust when damp, which matters for laundry going straight onto the hanger.

products.name: Amazon Basics Velvet Non-Slip Skirt Hangers with Clips 24 Pack
products.verdict: A velvet hanger with dual clips, notched shoulders and a swivel hook, in a pack of 24.
products.description:
These Amazon Basics hangers have a velvet surface, dual clips, notched shoulders and a 360 degree swivel hook. They come in a 24-pack and cost under $25.

They win because they cope with the most garments. Dual clips hold skirts and trousers by the waistband without bunching, the notched shoulders catch straps and light tops that would otherwise slip, and velvet grips fabric so it stays put. The swivel hook lets you turn the hanger to face a garment outward on a rod. A 24-pack is large enough to equip most of a closet at once. Velvet does shed lint onto some dark clothing.

Buy them for a closet with a mix of skirts, trousers and light tops. Check the clip pressure on the heaviest pants you own.
pros: Dual clips suit skirts and pants
cons: Clip strength on heavy denim is unstated
products.idealFor: A mixed closet of skirts, trousers and lightweight tops.
products.skipIf: You hang heavy denim or wool coats.

products.name: HOUSE DAY 14 Inch Clear Pants Hangers with Clips 12 Pack
products.verdict: Adjustable metal clips with rubber pads on a clear plastic body, rated for 5 lb each.
products.description:
The HOUSE DAY hangers are 14 inches wide, with adjustable metal clips that carry rubber pads, a clear plastic body and a stated load of 5 lb per hanger. They come as 12 for under $25.

They take second place because the rubber pads answer the main complaint about clip hangers, which is marks. A padded jaw spreads pressure over a larger area, so a skirt hem or a pair of dress trousers comes off without a crease. Adjustable clips fit different widths of waistband, and the stated 5 lb rating is useful: it tells you these will hold a pair of jeans or a lined skirt. The pack of 12 is smaller than the velvet 24, and the clear plastic body offers no shoulder notches.

Buy them for delicate skirts and dress trousers where marks matter. Pick velvet if you need to hold straps or tops.
pros: Clear body is easy to see through
products.idealFor: Skirts and delicate trousers where clip marks are the main worry.
products.skipIf: You need to hang tops with straps.

products.name: HOME IT Ivory Velvet Pants Hangers with Clips 10 Pack
products.verdict: A triangular, space-saving ivory velvet hanger with adjustable, anti-slip clips.
products.description:
The HOME IT hangers are ivory velvet, with adjustable strong clips, a triangular space-saving shape and an anti-slip design. They come 10 to a pack and cost under $25.

Third place fits because the triangular shape is slimmer than a rectangular hanger, which matters when a rod is crowded. The velvet adds grip, and the ivory colour looks tidy in a light-colored closet. It loses points to the Amazon Basics because it has fewer pieces and a single set of clips, so it cannot carry as many shapes of garment. A 10-pack covers a small collection of bottoms.

Buy it for delicate skirts and trousers in a closet that is already full. Skip it if you need dark-colored hangers that hide lint.
pros: Ivory looks clean in light closets
products.idealFor: Light-colored closets with delicate skirts and trousers.
products.skipIf: You want a dark color that hides marks.

products.name: ZOBER Chrome Metal Pants Hangers with Clips 20 Pack
products.verdict: Chrome metal hangers with adjustable clips and stackable hooks, 20 to a pack.
products.description:
The ZOBER hangers are chrome metal with adjustable clips, a non-slip grip and stackable hooks. They come in a pack of 20 and cost under $25.

Fourth place goes to them because metal clips hold a firmer grip than plastic, and a chrome frame is strong enough to carry heavier trousers without bending. Stackable hooks let you hang bottoms vertically, one below another, which saves rod width on a short rail. The drawback is that metal clips can leave a sharper pinch mark, and chrome over steel can rust if it stays damp. A metal hanger suits a dry closet.

Buy them for heavier pants and for stacking in a short closet. Dry clothing fully before hanging it.
cons: Chrome can rust if kept damp
products.idealFor: Short rods where stacking bottoms vertically is acceptable.
products.skipIf: You hang delicate fabrics or damp laundry.

products.name: Utopia Home Skirt Hangers 30 Pack with Clips
products.verdict: Thirty lightweight plastic hangers that will not rust, with swivel hooks.
products.description:
The Utopia Home set contains 30 lightweight plastic skirt hangers with clips, a 360 degree swivel hook and a compact profile. The listing notes they will not rust, and they cost under $25.

Fifth place suits them because the plastic body is the safe choice for wet laundry. Skirts and light bottoms can go from the wash onto a hanger and dry on a rack, and nothing will corrode. Thirty pieces is the biggest pack here and the best unit price. They are light, which means they are not for heavy trousers, and the listing does not describe the clips or give a load.

Buy them for lightweight skirts and shorts, especially on a drying rack. Use sturdier hangers for jeans.
pros: Will not rust on wet laundry
products.idealFor: Skirts and light bottoms that go straight from the wash to a drying rack.
products.skipIf: You hang jeans or heavy wool.

products.name: Hanger Central 12 Inch Slim Plastic Clip Hangers 30 Pack
products.verdict: Slim 12 inch black plastic hangers with ridged pinch clips, sized for shorts and kids' wear.
products.description:
The Hanger Central hangers are 12 inches wide, slim black plastic with ridged pinch clips. They are listed as suitable for kids' clothes and come in packs of 30 or 12, for under $25.

They rank sixth because the 12 inch width is on the small side, which suits shorts, skirts and children's clothing but short-changes adult trousers. The slim body saves rod space, and the ridged pinch clips give some bite on fabric. Black plastic hides lint and does not show dirt. The grip is plastic on fabric, with no rubber pad, so it can leave a mark on fine cloth.

Buy them for a child's closet or for shorts and skirts in tight spaces. Do not use them for full-size trousers.
cons: 12 inch width is too small for adults
No rubber pad on the clips
products.idealFor: Shorts, skirts and children's clothing in tight closets.

products.name: GUANJUNE Pants Hangers with Adjustable Clips 10 Pack
products.verdict: A ten-pack of space-saving hangers with adjustable clips and a swivel hook.
products.description:
The GUANJUNE hangers measure 29 by 14 by 3 centimeters, have adjustable clips and a 360 degree swivel hook, and are described as space saving. They come 10 to a pack for under $25.

They rank last because the listing gives little to separate them from the others. At about 11.4 inches wide, they sit in the small to middling range, and the page does not mention padding, velvet or load. They suit skirts and shorts well enough, and the swivel hook helps in a crowded rod. Adjustable clips fit a range of waistbands.

Buy them as a cheap first set to try clip hangers. If you want a more refined clip, pick one of the padded or velvet sets above.
products.idealFor: A first set of clip hangers for skirts and shorts.
products.skipIf: You want padded or velvet grips.

whatMatters.detail: The clip is what touches the fabric, and a padded or velvet jaw spreads pressure and prevents creases. A bare metal jaw can leave a line, especially on fine cloth. Look for rubber pads or velvet in the listing.
Adjustable clips slide along the hanger so they can be set to the width of a skirt or waistband. Fixed clips fit fewer garments. Check for the word adjustable on the page.
Velvet grips fabric and stops slipping, plastic is light and rust-free, and chrome metal is strong but can corrode in damp conditions. Choose by what you hang and whether you hang wet laundry.
A 12 inch hanger suits kids' clothes and shorts, while a 14 inch hanger suits adult trousers. A triangular or slim shape saves rod space. Match the width to your garments.
Packs run from 10 to 30, and cost per hanger falls as the pack grows. A swivel hook lets you turn the garment, and a stackable hook saves space. Check both on the listing.

faq.q: Will clip hangers leave marks on my clothes?
faq.a: They can, especially bare metal or hard plastic clips on fine fabric. Padded and velvet clips lower the risk. Clip near the seam or waistband band to hide any mark.

faq.q: What is the common mistake with clip hangers?
faq.a: Using clips on a thin waistband and hanging heavy trousers by the hem. Hang by the waistband for a firm hold. Pairing the hanger's rating with the garment weight avoids slippage.

faq.q: Are clip hangers worth it over regular hangers?
faq.a: For skirts, shorts and trousers they are, because the clip holds a garment without folding it over a bar, so there is no crease. For shirts and dresses, a regular hanger is better. Many closets use both.

faq.q: Can I hang wet laundry on them?
faq.a: Plastic hangers are fine, and velvet ones are acceptable if the fabric is only slightly damp. Avoid chrome metal for wet items, since it can rust. Let clothing dry before long-term storage.

faq.q: How many clip hangers do I need?
faq.a: Count the skirts, shorts and trousers you own and add about 20 percent. Packs of 10 to 30 cover most closets. A mixed set of velvet and metal can handle both light and heavy items.

faq.q: How do I clean velvet hangers?
faq.a: Use a lint roller or a soft brush to remove dust and fibers. Wipe stains with a barely damp cloth. Avoid soaking, as that can lift the velvet.

finalTake: The Amazon Basics velvet 24-pack is the best clip hanger for most closets, thanks to dual clips and a strong grip. The HOUSE DAY padded set is the pick for delicate skirts, and the ZOBER metal hangers carry heavier trousers. For kids' clothes and shorts, the Hanger Central 12 inch pack is the compact choice.
